comparator.name: Health and Life Sciences (Gezondheid en Leven)
comparator.academicYear: Fall 2026 entrant under the phased 2026–27 new curriculum
comparator.sourceNotes: The adopted 2026–27 OER establishes ten compulsory first-year 6-EC courses (60 EC), a Dutch instruction language, a 30-EC minimum third-year free-choice semester, and the absence of the old BMW/DGZ/KW specialisations for 2026 entrants. Its year-two major tables and thesis-credit alternatives still describe the outgoing specialised curriculum as that curriculum is phased out. VU's new-curriculum explanation specifies six compulsory second-year courses plus four choice slots, including one of Genomica/Kwalitatief onderzoek and one of Anatomie en fysiologie 2/Systeemtransformatie. The programme page's broad 'Verplichte vakken' list includes both alternatives in those pairs; it cannot be read as ten simultaneously compulsory courses. The new third-year biomedical or societal research project and science-communication course are identified, but their applicable credit weights and the complete year-two choice rules are not yet established by these sources. The formal study-guide programme page confirms the 180-EC, Dutch-taught degree but exposes no complete future-cohort credit table here. The registry's ENG language provenance conflicts with both this official study guide and the OER; the Dutch programme identity itself is unambiguous. No outgoing-track weights are borrowed for the new cohort.
components: Third-year minor or approved free-choice semester
OER article 12.1 establishes at least 30 EC; the new-curriculum explanation places the minor in periods 1–3. This records the 30-EC minimum only, without selecting a minor.

exception.reason: For a Fall 2026 entrant the new curriculum has no old specialisations. The adopted 2026–27 OER gives exact first-year and minimum minor credits, but its detailed year-two and thesis-credit tables concern the outgoing specialisations. The current new-curriculum explanation names the six-plus-four second-year structure and third-year research and communication work without their applicable EC and full choice allocation. Importing the old 24-EC or 18-EC thesis weights, or treating both members of each restricted choice pair as compulsory, would misstate the 2026-cohort 180-EC route. A lossless external comparison therefore remains unresolved.
exception.curriculumContext: Official study guide and OER identify a 180-EC Dutch-taught bachelor; the normalized registry incorrectly carries ENG as language provenance, which warrants a separate registry correction. The supported 60-EC compulsory first year and 30-EC minimum minor are retained, totaling a 90-EC known subset, not a complete degree. The new year-two six compulsory/four choice structure, restricted pairs, and third-year research/communication sequence are described in the VU curriculum revision, but the exact 2027–29 credit-bearing plan for this entrant is not determined by the adopted 2026–27 tables. Revisit once VU publishes the applicable new-cohort year-two/year-three component credits and choice rules.
